homepage.title: AI-First Engineering & UI/UX Design
homepage.subtitle: Custom Web Engineering & Web Application Development in Alicante
homepage.teams_title: Helping teams around the world ship winning products faster
homepage.teams_subtitle: 25+ years building websites, apps, interactive installations and digital products for art and education institutions, governments, start-ups, SMEs and multinational corporations — now supercharged with AI
homepage.slide1_subtitle: From idea to edge-deployed product — built to last and built to scale.
homepage.slide1_block1_body: Shipping production-grade websites with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/ui — accelerated by AI coding tools. Deployed to the edge via Cloudflare Pages for ultra-fast, globally distributed, mobile-first performance that is cheaper and safer to maintain
homepage.slide1_block2_body: Building type-safe, SEO-friendly full-stack apps with React and TanStack. Backend powered by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime) and Cloudflare Workers for serverless edge APIs — maximizing robustness, scalability and time-to-market
homepage.slide1_block3_body: Type-safe code with TypeScript and clean formatting via Prettier and ESLint. GitHub repos with automated CI/CD. Edge hosting on Cloudflare Pages. Supabase Row-Level Security. Preview deployments, postmortems and security audits
homepage.slide1_block4_body: Fast & flexible iterations with Roadmaps, Scrum, Kanban and sprints — accelerated by AI coding assistants to eliminate scope creep. Semantic Releases, living documentation and a single source of truth to keep teams aligned at speed
homepage.slide2_title: Consistent and user-centered UI UX design
homepage.slide2_subtitle: When finesse and attention to detail align with easy user journeys and natural interfaces, the magic happens
homepage.slide2_block1_body: Before and after building the tech, every product has to be validated by potential users and their feedback taken onboard. This will save you time and money
homepage.slide2_block2_body: Building consistent, accessible and themeable design systems with Figma, Shadcn/ui, Radix primitives and Storybook — with design tokens that keep code and design in perfect sync across all products
homepage.slide2_block3_body: Standing out and connecting deeply with users through fluid micro-animations with Framer Motion, immersive 3D experiences with Three.js / WebGPU, and AI-generated visuals that make every interaction memorable
homepage.slide2_block4_body: Logos, landing pages and pitch decks — accelerated by AI tools like Midjourney. Smooth Lottie animations, Notion-powered documentation sites and video production that brings brands to life
homepage.slide3_title: Data and Content Management that scales
homepage.slide3_subtitle: Keeping your data and your customers' data safe, well organized and easy to update
homepage.slide3_block1_body: Keeping content decoupled from your front-end with StoryBlok, Contentful, Sanity, Payload CMS or Strapi — or using Notion as a lightweight, team-friendly CMS backed by markdown
homepage.slide3_block2_body: Lightweight, type-safe APIs with Hono.js on Cloudflare Workers and end-to-end type safety with tRPC. Database powered by Supabase (Postgres + pgvector for AI) and Drizzle ORM — zero-overhead, fully type-safe
homepage.slide3_block3_body: Running at the edge with Cloudflare Workers, KV, R2 and Durable Objects. Supabase for managed Postgres + Auth + Storage. Vercel for preview deployments and ISR — leaving AWS/GCP for workloads that genuinely need them
homepage.slide3_block4_body: Optimising LCP, CLS and INP to stay firmly in the green. Global asset delivery via Cloudflare CDN, next-gen image optimisation with Cloudflare Images and edge streaming for sub-second TTFB worldwide
